# Hatch Light Switch Installation

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Install a three-position switch to control the cargo light circuit using power from its red wire. [t905]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Install a three-position switch (ON-OFF-ON) to control the light circuit.
2. Tap power from the cargo light's red wire for constant voltage access.
3. Connect the center connector of the new switch to the output side of your LED lights.
4. Route one outside connector back up to the original blue ground wire (active when hatch opens).
5. Attach the final outside connector to a convenient body ground.

_Procedure reported by [t905]._

## Tips & gotchas

- The middle position on this switch setup is 'off', while either side provides power. [t905]
- [Partial] Use insulated male/female spade connectors if soldering grounds back onto the original latch switch. [t905]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Losing small screws for hatch light holders during disassembly. [t905]
